key_decisions: MpiNodes is AGPL-3.0 from 1.2.7 onward (1.2.6 and earlier stay MIT). Fabio is sole copyright holder - 65 commits, 0 PRs - so the relicence was clean. The licence is now the moat, replacing the withheld-registry-release tactic that could never work with both repos public.
LanPaint ships as a PINNED third-party dep plus a MadPonyInteractive fork, never vendored into MpiNodes or Vision - it is GPL-3.0 and copying it would relicence a first-party repo permanently.
9B ships styleless for now: Input_is_9b bypasses both the styles prompt concat and the style LoRA stack. Styles for 9B are a later version.
Turbo and KV are both dead (MPI-600). The bench template no longer contains any turbo node.
constraints: The saved bench template klein_t2i_template.json is a 4B template MID-EDIT - UNETLoader and CLIPLoader already hold 9B weights while Input_is_9b is false and both LoRA loaders still point at 4B files. Do not read it as a finished 9B template.
There is NO 9B outpaint LoRA. flux2-klein-4b-outpaint has no identified equivalent, and a 4B LoRA cannot apply to a 9B model. LoraLoaderModelOnly loads the file even at strength 0.
On HuggingFace the resolve-URL ETag is a CDN etag, NOT the LFS sha256. Use POST /api/models/{repo}/paths-info/main and read lfs.oid, or a good download reads as corrupt.
CivitAI is UK-region-blocked (HTTP 000 bare). Anything from there needs the VPN on, and the VPN also skews the system clock - check gh api rate_limit Date before trusting timestamps.
MPI-601 is finished but still sits in doing at validating - it needs mpi-end-session to close, not more work.
